readings.summary: SuppressSourceGeneration must disable only source generation, while the MessagePack analyzers continue running and reporting applicable MsgPack0xx diagnostics as they did in 3.1.0.
readings.code_difference: Analyzer registration or execution must no longer be gated by SuppressSourceGeneration=true, but generated source must still be omitted and behavior when the property is false or unset must remain unchanged.
